status: Implemented; native/GPU checks and actual Main comparisons completed. Focused performance unverified.
changes: Captured Main 1.6.6 effective defaults and applied its seven overrides as new source defaults.
Added sun-local halo strength/radius and core-brightness controls without changing global bloom.
Added independent vanilla/realistic face-component multipliers; both 1 reproduce the previous combination.
Increased cirrus optical contrast/density and added independent cirrus-density control.
Added rain-gated, view-dependent film/highlights on exposed absorbent materials while retaining sheltered matte retention.

native.scope: Native OpenGL compatibility-shim compile/link; not a substitute for Iris loading

reviewed: Wet off/default/maximum in rain; nonporous metal; clear material
Corrected Lighting/Sun/Materials menus and Cloud menu

performance.notes: Main was initially unfocused; no valid focused FPS result. Preferred quality defaults match saved Main settings; all four quality presets remain unchanged. No extra render pass or scenery trace; dry/nonporous film work bypassed. No maximised-performance or full visual-equivalence claim.

limits: Wet film is an environment/solar approximation, not ray-traced coating or simulated rain accumulation; existing absorption classes are heuristic.
Bright high clouds form a broad veil rather than dense cumulonimbus; finite slab/horizon limits remain.
Rain/cloud animation means visual comparisons are controlled but not pixel-identical.
Full night/sheltered-wet and exhaustive preset/motion/mod visual coverage are not claimed.
Existing screen-space water and depth-miss fallback costs remain; actual dense-forest focused profiling still needed.
